approvals.rationale: Restore the original two-part research question, align H2/H3 with the experiments actually reported, and scope the map claim as predictive description rather than regime classification.
approvals.provenance: Thesis-author instruction dated 2026-11-26 supplied the exact Spanish main question and requested manuscript alignment plus a consent, rationale and provenance guard; the English main question is its translation and H2/H3 are aligned evaluation questions.

main.en: Under what conditions of arbitrage capacity and liquidity depth does a constant-product AMM track an exogenous CEX price after a perturbation, and how accurately does a reduced dynamic map describe the tracking regimes obtained in a micro-world with heterogeneous agents?
main.es: ¿Bajo qué condiciones de capacidad de arbitraje y profundidad de liquidez un AMM de producto constante sigue un precio CEX exógeno después de una perturbación, y con qué precisión un mapa dinámico reducido describe los regímenes de seguimiento obtenidos en un micromundo con agentes heterogéneos?

h2.en: Within the tested capacity and depth levels, how does the specified one-time liquidity-withdrawal rule affect post-shock tracking, and how does that effect vary when order sizes scale with reserves or panic behavior is disabled?
h2.es: Dentro de los niveles de capacidad y profundidad ensayados, ¿cómo afecta al seguimiento posterior al choque la regla especificada de retiro único de liquidez, y cómo varía ese efecto cuando el tamaño de las órdenes escala con las reservas o se desactiva la conducta de pánico?

h3.en: How accurately does the two-state map predict held-out tracking-error paths relative to persistence and a scalar AR(1), and how does a band-aware map perform against the affine map in recursive replay?
h3.es: ¿Con qué precisión predice el mapa de dos estados las trayectorias reservadas del error de seguimiento frente a la persistencia y un AR(1) escalar, y cómo se desempeña un mapa sensible a la banda frente al mapa afín en la reproducción recursiva?

approvals.approvedBy: Thesis author, by explicit instruction to revise the questions if needed
approvals.rationale: The prior wording asked how accurately a reduced map describes tracking regimes, but the reported evaluation predicts continuous tracking-error paths and does not test independently labeled regimes. The revised wording limits the question to the tested parameter grid and the measured trajectory-prediction target without changing the study's substantive two-part purpose.
